company.name: Liquid Death
company.description: Liquid Death is a canned water brand founded in 2017 that has pursued bold, unconventional branding and marketing to differentiate itself within the bottled/canned water and beverage industry (E3).

customers.primary_user: end consumers seeking hydration who choose packaged beverages (E8, E9, E11)
customers.buyer: consumers purchasing at retail or online (grocery, convenience, direct-to-consumer) (E11)
segments: consumers concerned with environmental impact and brand loyalty (E13)
consumers attracted to distinctive/edgy branding and marketing (E3)

business_model.value_proposition: Branded canned water positioned via unconventional, bold marketing and packaging to stand out from traditional bottled water incumbents (E3)
business_model.revenue_model: Product sales through retail and online direct-to-consumer channels (E11)
cost_drivers: production and packaging of canned water (industry incumbents focus on production and distribution) (E14)

direct_competitors: other bottled/canned water brands and premium water brands (E14)
